purpose: Confirm or reject the post-P2 duration-augmented active-byte model on unopened GH200 batch/context coordinates.

development_data.interpretation: model-development-only; includes the original identification and first held-out campaigns because the duration term was selected after inspecting both

frozen_model.equation: E_token = intercept + alpha_weight * weight_decimal_GB_per_token + beta_kv * kv_read_write_decimal_GB_per_token + p_time_W * decode_seconds_per_useful_token
frozen_model.prediction_timing: retrospective-per-run: decode duration is observed over the same boundary-aligned interval; this is not an advance scheduler forecast unless duration is separately predicted

primary_gates.unit_of_analysis: cell mean over five independent runs

claim_policy.passing_result: supports a same-stack duration-augmented accounting model on the tested GH200 interpolation domain
claim_policy.failing_result: retains traffic closure and rejects this V2 energy closure
not_authorized: causal interpretation of p_time_watts as literal idle power
